req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-038 requires that when a PUT /tasks/{id} request includes an 'id' field in the body, the system ignores it and mutates only the task addressed by the URL path parameter. The TaskUpdate schema does not include an 'id' field, so FastAPI/Pydantic will silently strip it. Tests must verify: (1) positive — body with a different id value still updates the correct task and the response id matches the URL id; (2) negative — body with a non-existent URL id returns 404 regardless of body id; (3) boundary — body id equals URL id (no-op conflict) still succeeds and returns the URL-addressed task; (4) additional EP — body id attempts to redirect to another existing task but URL task is updated correctly. Assertions use exact values to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_put_ignores_body_id_updates_url_task():
    engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    db = TestingSession()
    from app import models
    db.add(models.Task(id=5, title='Write project report', description='desc', completed=False))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    def override_get_db():
        db2 = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db2
        finally:
            db2.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.put('/tasks/5', json={'title': 'Updated title', 'id': 99})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 5
    assert body['title'] == 'Updated title'
    assert body['completed'] == False
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_put_ignores_body_id_updates_url_task()

import os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_put_body_id_different_existing_task_does_not_mutate_that_task():
    engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    db = TestingSession()
    from app import models
    db.add(models.Task(id=2, title='Book flight tickets', description='desc', completed=True))
    db.add(models.Task(id=3, title='Submit expense report', description='desc2', completed=True))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    def override_get_db():
        db2 = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db2
        finally:
            db2.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_put = client.put('/tasks/2', json={'title': 'New title for 2', 'id': 3})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    put_body = r_put.json()
    assert put_body['id'] == 2
    assert put_body['title'] == 'New title for 2'
    r_get = client.get('/tasks/3')
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    get_body = r_get.json()
    assert get_body['id'] == 3
    assert get_body['title'] == 'Submit expense report'
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()
